entries.title: Esa gotera no se arregla sola
entries.intro: ¿Esa gotera sigue pendiente? ConectaProIA te ayuda a buscar contactos de gasfitería para tu hogar.
entries.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished premium Spanish-language advertising poster for ConectaProIA, a Chilean directory of professional/service contacts. Portrait 4:5 aspect ratio, ideally 1080x1350. This is a new original campaign, highly professional editorial art direction, instantly readable on a phone.
Design: warm ivory #F6F4E9, deep forest green #083F33, bold orange accent #FF653E. Main visual is a beautiful, believable close-up photograph of a normal household kitchen tap with a single water drop about to fall, in a tidy sunny Chilean home. Tactile photographic detail, compelling warm light, no person needed, no damage/disaster, no unsafe repair. Realistic water drop. Bold contemporary oversized typography in a carefully aligned editorial composition, generous whitespace, strong obvious hierarchy. Distinctive ad agency polish. No fake app screenshot, badges, testimonials, guarantee, clocks, made-up provider names, QR codes or watermark.
Exact Spanish copy, all spelled correctly and legible:
Small brand at top: "ConectaProIA"
Large primary headline: "¿Esa gotera sigue pendiente?"
Supporting line: "Busca contactos de gasfitería según tu comuna."
High contrast action panel: "Dinos qué necesitas + tu comuna"
Contact instruction: "Escríbenos por WhatsApp"
Large readable phone: "+56 9 8343 4503"
Website: "conectaproia.cl"
Small clear benefit: "Buscar contactos es gratis."
Small readable footer: "El servicio lo cobra cada profesional."
Keep ALL copy and phone completely inside a generous 8% inset border; do not place copy over busy photo. Phone and main CTA readable at thumbnail size. Maintain spacious typography with accurate Spanish accents. The action panel is poster artwork, not an imitation clickable app button. Output the finished poster only.
entries.cta: Cuéntanos qué necesitas y en qué comuna buscas atención.

entries.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE high-impact finished Spanish advertising poster for ConectaProIA, Chilean service-contact directory. Portrait 4:5, ideally 1080x1350. Original striking Swiss editorial / modern Latin American brand campaign. Use deep midnight teal #103E37 background, warm cream typography, vivid lime #C7EB45 accents, exquisite spacing and oversized bold geometric sans-serif type. A sophisticated sculptural 3D location-pin motif in lime and translucent cream floating on subtle abstract concentric topographic lines; one central pin with beautiful lighting.
